Game Overview

Sword Slinger is a action title where unleash your inner warrior in Sword Slinger. Master the art of precision and agility as you hurl your sword against hordes of monsters and zombies. Navigate a captivating pixelated world that demands quick reflexes and cunning strategy to survive relentless enemies. How long can you withstand the escalating chaos?
